scenes.text: Did you know that the legendary Mona Lisa was actually a completely obscure painting until someone literally walked out of the Louvre museum with it tucked under their arm in 1911?
Before this mind-blowing heist, it wasn't even the most popular piece in its own gallery room, but when a rogue employee hid the masterpiece and escaped, the entire world went absolutely wild.
Suddenly, massive crowds of people were lining up for hours just to stare at the empty space on the wall where the artwork used to hang, turning it into an overnight media sensation.

By the time the painting was recovered two years later, this bizarre fame had cemented it as the most famous masterpiece in human history, so tell us if you would ever queue up to see a blank wall and follow for more!
